fields.Name: T104 - Open Existing Dashboard
fields.Description: Verifies that an existing dashboard can be opened from the Data Explorer Dashboards browser and that its panels/widgets render (or a valid empty dashboard state) without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) to open the Data Explorer app, then go to its Dashboards section (route /app/data-explorer/Dashboards). If one or more dashboards are listed, click into one to open it — success is the opened dashboard showing its panels/widgets (or a valid empty dashboard with no widgets). If NO dashboards exist (the section shows a 'Welcome to Dashboards' / empty state indicating 0 dashboards), then verify that empty state renders cleanly with no errors — that is ALSO success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for the section to finish loading, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Data Explorer Dashboards section was reached and rendered its content

EITHER an existing dashboard was opened (its name/title and panels/widgets or an empty-dashboard state visible), OR — if no dashboards exist — the Dashboards list shows a clearly-labeled empty state (e.g. 'Welcome to Dashboards' / 0 dashboards) rendered cleanly
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
